title: PowerSmart 1850 PSI Electric Pressure Washer (DW1018B)

comparisons.notes: PowerSmart 1850 PSI washer with 5-inch wheels, 23-ft kink-resistant hose and hose hook; listing copy matches the DW1018B. No MPN or UPC shown on the page; in stock.

writeup: Woot has the PowerSmart DW1018B electric pressure washer new for $54.99, while TaskHolt lists the same 1850 max PSI washer at $124.55. It rolls on 5-inch wheels and comes with a 23-ft kink-resistant hose and a hose hook. Woot stock is thin, with a limit of 3 per order.
amazon_match_notes: Checker matched ASIN B0FH53TNH4 to PowerSmart DW1018B, UPC 840432710838, red.
